remarks: Newly renovated 1 bedroom apartment (770 SQ. FT.) located in the middle of the action. Steps away from lively downtown Stamford, including: popular eateries, bars, theaters, parks, shopping, clothing stores, health club, library, UConn Stamford Campus, commuter train station, hotels, government center and yet in a quiet part of the street! The apartment is bright, warm and spacious with an updated bathroom, a beautiful new kitchen, now featuring extra cabinets in the dining area, and updated floors throughout - be the first user! Bedroom comes equipped with a beautiful full length curtain & curtain rod. 24 hours secured front entrance, well decorated lobby and sitting area friendly welcome your visitors. Prefer some personal time and space? Just sit by your large private balcony and enjoy the great view of downtown. Laundry facility and extra storage conveniently located on the first level for your personal belongings and bike. A parking spot can be easily rented from Bedford Street Garage. Heat, gas, hot water, water, property management (trash collection and snow removal) are all included. Dogs are not allowed. Unit to be professional cleaned prior to move in. Available 11.1.24
